images.title: Four deals sold as recurring
images.alt: Four affiliate commission structures: lifetime recurring, time-limited recurring, hybrid rates and one-time bounty.
images.caption: "Recurring" describes several different deals, so read which one the terms actually promise.

items.title: Lifetime recurring
items.text: Paid as long as the customer pays. Confirm the terms say so.

items.title: Time-limited recurring
items.text: Paid for a fixed period, then it ends.

items.title: Hybrid
items.text: A high rate for the first year, then a lower rate afterwards.

items.title: One-time bounty
items.text: A flat amount or a share of the first payment only.

images.after: What to check before you promote a program
images.title: Read the affiliate terms for these
images.alt: Checklist of SaaS affiliate terms to check: commission type, attribution window, refunds, payout threshold, promotion rules, termination clauses.
images.caption: The sales page leaves most of this out, so go to the affiliate terms themselves.

items: Commission type, duration and any drop after year one
What happens on upgrades, downgrades and refunds
Promotion rules, such as brand-name bidding
Whether existing referrals keep paying after changes
